title: Boots of Speed

sources.title: Click Heels
markers: | description = Click the heels of your boots to gain speed and freedom of movement.

summary: Click Heels doubles movement speed for the turn. The pinned source reports that its disadvantage applies to the wearer’s own reaction attacks.

fields.Effect: Click Heels costs a Bonus Action and doubles the wearer’s movement speed for the current turn.
fields.Reported game behavior: The tooltip describes disadvantage on enemy opportunity attacks. The pinned source reports a scripting bug that instead applies disadvantage to the wearer’s own reaction attacks.
fields.Base value: 190 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay use and pinned evidence, then refined its mechanics against item and linked rule notes.
